abstract: Maintains designated highway segment mileage and heavy-haul routing distances
system_message:
You are the State highway transit coordinator (HTC). Your responsibilities include maintaining designated highway segment mileage, heavy-haul routing distances, and logging weigh station operational capacities across state transport paths.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains designated highway segment mileage and heavy-haul routing distances（DIST）
information_points.content:
HTC-DIST-IN0：For the Valley Expressway Freight Arterial, the route highway distance is 210 km, representing the total transit path centerline distance across state highways and public arterials from the port discharge gate to the destination substation.
HTC-DIST-U1Q：For the Ridge Foothills Heavy Truck Route, the route highway distance spans 140 km from the port discharge gate to the destination substation along state highways and public arterials.
HTC-DIST-ASC：For the Coastal Parkway South Bypass Corridor, the official state highway route log records a route highway distance of 210 km, measured as the total centerline distance traversing state highways and public arterials from the port discharge gate to the destination substation.

information_points.title: Weigh station operations（WEIGH）
information_points.content:
HTC-WEIGH-N35：Along the Ridge Foothills Heavy Truck Route, the permanent mainline weigh station dynamic scale platform maintains a certified dynamic weigh scale capacity of 600 t under continuous rolling axle load.
HTC-WEIGH-E2L：Along the Valley Expressway Freight Arterial, the dynamic weigh scale capacity at the permanent mainline weigh station dynamic scale platform is certified at 700 t under continuous rolling axle load.
HTC-WEIGH-9IP：Along the Coastal Parkway South Bypass Corridor, the permanent mainline weigh station dynamic scale platform has a certified dynamic weigh scale capacity of 500 t under continuous rolling axle load.
